text:
maya: Quick thread  experiment for the pricing & packaging calculator: show an inline "what next" strip after results with three lightweight choices (Demo / Webinar / Continue). The aim is to capture intent and seed webinar invites without forcing a modal. Thoughts?

owen: Yes. Keep it subtle. If estimate > $1800 show Demo first. Otherwise default to Webinar. No sitewide naming changes.

felix: Copy tests: headline variants: "Next steps tailored to your estimate" vs "Choose how you'd like to proceed". CTA text variants too: "Book a demo" / "Talk to sales" and "Join webinar" / "See a short walkthrough". We'll A/B them.

sara: UX note  inline strip under the calculator results, pill buttons for choices, small FAQ link that opens accordion to the right. Keep keyboard focus and screen-reader labels.

jorge: Sales ops: route demo leads where calc_estimate_usd >= 1500 to SDR webhook. Include is_enterprise_candidate boolean. Also include preferred_cta_label so SDR knows which copy converted. Mask prompt content everywhere.

maya: Analytics event plan: only emit once per session or on CTA click (debounce). Proposed event shape (we'll include as a text snippet):
```
window.dataLayer.push({
  event: 'pricing_next_strip_select',
  path: 'demo|webinar|self',
  estimate_usd: 2200,
  exp_id: 'exp_pricing_strip_11',
  variant: 'A|B',
  is_enterprise_candidate: true
});
```
Send webhook for demo path when enterprise flag true and estimate above threshold.

owen: Experiment params: exp_pricing_strip_11, variant A = headline 1 + CTA set 1, variant B = headline 2 + CTA set 2. Start with 7-day run, measure demo bookings per visitor and webinar signups. Secondary: 30d trial->paid.

felix: Tier-label microtest idea (micro-only): show alternative labels inside the strip only: Set Alpha = Reserved / Burst / Managed; Set Beta = Dedicated / Flexible / Hosted. Don't change the main pricing table. We'll ladder microcopy under each label to test clarity.

sara: Accessibility: ensure pills are aria-pressed and announce the chosen state. Also ensure the FAQ accordion anchor is reachable.

jorge: Webhook spec example (as a snippet in the thread):
POST /webhooks/sdr
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "email": "lead@example.com",
  "company": "Acme",
  "estimate_usd": "2200",
  "path": "demo",
  "is_enterprise_candidate": "true",
  "preferred_cta_label": "Book a demo",
  "source": "pricing_calculator"
}
Mask any prompt text and PII where appropriate.

maya: Timeline: mocks by Tue, analytics spec by Wed, dev spike Thurs, staging QA Fri, 10% rollout next Tue. Who owns the mock?

felix: I'll mock visuals and microcopy variants today. ETA 5pm.

owen: Dev: please add debounce so only final selection fires the pricing_next_strip_select event OR fire on CTA click. Also include session_id + utm params for joins.

growth-bot: experiment created: exp_pricing_strip_11. Allocation: 50/50 for A/B. Start 2026-06-08.

jorge: Sales heads notified: /cc @sales-team. Expect webhook changes and new SDR lead shape.

sara: Also add a tiny optional micro-survey after CTA: single-question "Was this helpful?" (yes/no + optional comment). A/B with vs without. Keep it non-intrusive.

maya: Good. Measurement checklist: baseline CTR on pricing CTAs, demo booking rate, webinar attendance, 30d MQL conversion. Marcus from analytics, can you add dashboard widgets?

felix: Mock will include the two tier-label sets, both headline variants, and the FAQ snippets for each estimate band.

owen: One more: for the demo route, show a short privacy note: "We won't share your prompts without consent" with a link to the FAQ. Jorge, sales OK with that?

jorge: Yes. That helps for regulated accounts. Include privacy blurb in webhook payload as consent flag when applicable.

maya: Perfect. I'll assemble the rollout checklist and update the experiment doc with KPIs. Thanks team :thumbsup:
